protocol: Template groups are assigned to train, validation, and test before sampling, feature fitting, or threshold selection. Row caps are uniform inside one side, so they keep that side's anomaly prevalence. The validation side chooses the threshold. The test side is scored once. Hyperparameters stay at the benchmark values.

experiments.label_definition: The first whitespace-separated token is the published BGL alert label. '-' is normal. That token is removed before the template and the features.

experiments.label_definition: anomaly_labels.txt lists VM instance ids with injected anomalies. Every other instance id found in [instance: ...] or /servers/<id> is normal. experiments.feature_note: Each instance is one example. At most 40 normalized lines are kept per instance before the instance groups are split. Instance ids are replaced with <*>.
